Synthetic Carrd pages for `tests/site-platform-carrd.test.ts`. Modelled on the markup of public Carrd
sites studied on 2026-11-08 (classic `#wrapper > #main > .inner > section#<name>-section`, and the newer
`.site-main[role=main]` + `*-component instance-N` markup). The businesses, words, addresses, emails and
pictures are invented; nothing here is copied from a real site.
